description: This file defines the SaveOAuthClientController class within the OrangeHRM OAuth plugin module. The class extends an abstract Vue controller and manages the preparation of a Vue component for saving OAuth clients, optionally including an 'id' property based on request query parameters.

classes.name: SaveOAuthClientController
classes.description: Controller for handling OAuth client save operations, inheriting Vue.js-based component rendering capabilities.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering, adding an 'id' property if provided in the request query.
